description: Ladestruktur im öffentlichen Straßenraum is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This dataset contains information on all publicly accessible charging stations in the street space of the city of Cologne, which have been approved by the city of Cologne. The different phases (preliminary test positive/negative/critical, detailed test, arrangement carried out, in operation, out of operation) are superimposed. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Loading structure in public road space" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Infrastruktur, NRW, Verkehr, opendata, Ladesäuleninfrastruktur, Ladesäulen. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
